Le Rendez-vous Tech est l'un des podcast: Le Rendez-vous Tech is one of the most listened-to French-language tech podcasts. It covers digital news, new products and industry trends. Accessible yet demanding, it has established itself as a reference for tech enthusiasts.
Le podcast tech francophone de référence: The reference French-language tech podcast, hosted by Patrick Beja. Innovation, AI, social networks, digital ethics: each topic is put back in context with rigour and balance, far from simply relaying announcements. The motto sums it up: "There is no justice without accuracy." Our verdict: one of the best tech podcasts in French — informative, accessible, serious but never boring. If you want to stay up to date without drowning in the noise, it's a date not to miss.
